creator_type: parent creator (parenting tips account, "מאמא שפשוט" per the hashtag)
product: Ready-made clear plastic book-cover sleeves for school textbooks (brand not shown), demonstrated on two Israeli school textbooks ("יחד בישראל" and "פלא טבע")
format: silent hands-only top-down demo with a text-story narration (no speech)

hook_0_3s.opening_image: Top-down view of a grey stone surface with two blue schoolbooks, and a woman's hands with pink nails holding a large clear plastic sleeve over them.
hook_0_3s.on_screen_text: "אם במקרה חייתן כמוני במערה בשנים האחרונות" (0-2 s), then "ועד היום עטפתן ספרים עם גליל ענק, מספריים ודמעות" from about 2 s. The first line is partly overlapped by the books in the frame.
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: self-deprecating humour ('I lived in a cave') aimed at mothers who still wrap school books the hard way; the transparent sleeve in the hands hints at the fix.

shots.subject: Hands on a grey stone surface: a clear sleeve held up, a textbook slid in at about 3 to 5 s, the sleeve smoothed flat with an open hand at 5 to 9 s, then the book flipped and a second book shown covered at 12 to 17 s
shots.purpose: Shows the whole job done in a few seconds

how_value_is_shown: Text says the old way takes a giant roll, scissors and tears, and that this product "takes exactly 10 seconds" ("שלוקחת בדיוק 10 שניות..."). The video shows a book being slid into a sleeve and smoothed over in a few seconds.
demonstration: A textbook is placed into the sleeve, smoothed flat, flipped and fanned to show the cover is on; two books are shown covered at the end.
proof: The live demonstration only. The 10 seconds claim and the 'saved two days of work' claim are text only.
emotion: Humorous relief; text uses shocked and heart-eyes emojis.
personal_story: Text implies a long-standing chore (wrapping books with a roll and scissors) and that she only just bought the product. No further story.
selling_language: "שלוקחת בדיוק 10 שניות..."; "אז רק רציתי לעדכן שחסכתי יומיים עבודה"; caption: "רוצו לקנות את זה"
captions_on_screen: Centered white text with a dark outline in two to three lines that change every few seconds (headline text boxes, no speech to subtitle); emojis at the end of two lines.
editing_rhythm: One continuous 17.6 s take, no cuts detected, no speed changes noticed; the pacing comes from the text changes.
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: two covered books in her hands, text "(אם קניתן תרשמו באיזו חנות השגתן את זה...)" and "ובואו לעקוב לעוד טיפים ממש פשוטים". Caption asks readers who bought it to write where they found it and invites followers.
convincing: Interpretation: the one shot proves the claim at normal speed, the text sets up a relatable pain before the product shows, and no talking is needed.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: no brand or purchase info, the caption asks the audience where to buy it, which leaves viewers without a way to act, and the text is small relative to the frame.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: a silent top-down take with a joke-first text story and a single clean demonstration is easy to repeat with a phone on a table, for example a book being unwrapped or a page being flipped with the child's name. No face or voice needed.
solo_without_child: yes: only the creator's hands appear
not_verified: Product brand and where it is sold; whether she was paid; whether there is music or only room sound; the claim of saving two days of work.
